options.systemPromptTemplate:
You research a B2B prospect and draft a short first-contact email. A person reviews every draft before anything is sent.

RULES:
1. Use ONLY facts from the website text and fields provided. Never invent news, awards, funding, clients, social posts, mutual connections or past conversations.
2. If the website text is empty or unhelpful, do not claim anything specific about the company beyond its industry. Set usedWebsite to false.
3. Never state prices, discounts, savings figures, guarantees or results.
4. emailBody: 70 to 110 words, plain text, start with 'Hi <first name>,'. One specific, grounded observation, one sentence on how the offer could help, one soft ask (a short call or a reply). No signature and no opt-out line - those are added separately.
5. subjectLine: 7 words or fewer, no clickbait, never start with 'Re:' or 'Fwd:'.
6. companySummary: one plain sentence describing what the company does.
7. relevantHook: the single website fact the email is built on, or empty.
8. confidence: 0 to 1, how well the email is grounded in real facts.

## 1 · Find new prospects - free

The sales team fills in the form: job titles, locations, company size, industry and the offer.

**Apollo People Search costs no credits.** Everyone already in the Prospects sheet is skipped - whatever their status - so nobody is enriched or contacted twice.

The rest are ranked by title (owners and founders first), and only the top *Max to enrich* move on.

## 2 · Enrich - uses credits

Apollo Bulk Enrichment returns work email, email status, company size, industry and website - 10 people per call, one call every 1.5 seconds.

Personal emails and phone numbers are **not** requested.

## 3 · Score by rules, read the website

Points come from fixed rules, never AI: seniority, title match, verified email, company size, industry, has a website. Every prospect lists the reasons behind its score.

The company's own website is fetched and cleaned for the next step. A site that's down or blocked doesn't stop the run.

## 4 · AI researches & drafts - grounded only

AI writes a one-line company summary and a short first email.

It may only use facts from the website. No invented news, awards or mutual connections; no prices, savings or guarantees. If the website gave nothing useful, the email stays generic and is flagged.

## 5 · Review queue

Every prospect is written to the **Prospects** tab of a Google Sheet. Those scoring 60+ with a verified email are **pending_review**; the rest are **low_fit**, so they're never enriched again.

The client reviews in the sheet - the tool they already know - and changes status to **approved**.

Slack gets one digest per run, not one message per prospect.

## 6 · Approved → Pipedrive

Every 15 minutes, **approved** rows are added to Pipedrive one at a time:
- A row with no company or no valid email is set to **needs_fix** (reason in **crmNote**) and skipped - one bad row never blocks the rest
- Finds the organisation and person first, and creates them only if missing - no duplicates in the CRM
- Creates a deal, then **immediately** marks the row **in_crm** with the deal ID - so a later failure can never create a second deal
- Pins a note with the score, the reasons, the company research and the suggested first email

Nothing is emailed automatically - the sales rep sends from Pipedrive. If a step before the deal fails, the row stays **approved** and is retried next run.

## 7 · If something breaks

This branch runs whenever a live run fails. It works because the workflow is its own error workflow (**Settings > Error Workflow = this workflow**). If you import or duplicate it, select the copy there again.

Manual test runs don't trigger it.

Nothing is emailed automatically, so a failure can't contact anyone by mistake.

## Sample client: Harbourline Payroll Services (fictional)

Outbound prospecting for an outsourced payroll firm targeting SMEs. Uses Apollo's licensed B2B data - no LinkedIn scraping.

**Setup needed**

**Form login** - the request form is staff-only. Create a Basic Auth credential (user + password for the sales team) and select it in **Prospecting Request Form**.

**Apollo** - create a **master API key** (enrichment needs it). Add a Header Auth credential: name `x-api-key`, value = your key. Select it in both Apollo steps.

**Google Sheets** - the "Prospecting" spreadsheet is already created in Google Drive (Project Portfolio > Harbourline) and linked here. Rename its tab to **Prospects** and make sure these columns exist alongside the ones the first run writes: **pipedriveDealId**, **crmAt**, **crmNote**. Add a dropdown on **status**: pending_review, low_fit, approved, rejected, do_not_contact, in_crm, needs_fix. Connect a Google Sheets credential in all five Sheets steps.

**Pipedrive** - connect an API token credential in the six Pipedrive steps.

**Slack / OpenAI** - select your existing credentials.

**Errors** - already wired: Settings > Error Workflow points at this workflow. Re-select it if you import a copy.
